INSERT INTO report_variant_history (report_id, analysis_id, subbarcode, client, project_no, product, disease, source_type, source_id, gene, variant, abundance, variant_type, ori_variant, level, drug_info, analyzer, report_generated_at, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) VALUES
(#{r.reportId}, #{r.analysisId}, #{r.subbarcode}, #{r.client}, #{r.projectNo}, #{r.product}, #{r.disease}, #{r.sourceType}, #{r.sourceId}, #{r.gene}, #{r.variant}, #{r.abundance}, #{r.variantType}, #{r.oriVariant}, #{r.level}, #{r.drugInfo}, #{r.analyzer}, #{r.reportGeneratedAt}, #{r.createBy}, NOW(), #{r.updateBy}, NOW(), '0')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE level = VALUES(level), abundance = VALUES(abundance), variant_type = VALUES(variant_type), drug_info = VALUES(drug_info), analyzer = VALUES(analyzer), disease = VALUES(disease), client = VALUES(client), project_no = VALUES(project_no), product = VALUES(product), subbarcode = VALUES(subbarcode), report_generated_at = VALUES(report_generated_at), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = NOW(), del_flag = '0'
